options.name: status
options.description: Bus totals and whether this account is bound

options.name: whoami
options.description: The agent, Polar customer, and capabilities behind this account

options.name: send
options.description: Queue a message for an agent

options.name: inbox
options.description: Open messages for an agent (defaults to your own)

options.name: recipient
options.description: Agent id (defaults to the agent you are bound to)

options.name: ack
options.description: Acknowledge a message addressed to your agent

options.name: bind
options.description: Map a Discord account to an agent and Polar customer (operator or registry.admin)

options.name: customer
options.description: Polar customer id or external id — the source of the agent's capabilities

options.name: user
options.description: Discord user id to bind (defaults to you)

options.name: username
options.description: Label for the bound account, when binding someone else
